news-korea-econ.title: NIIF eyes Japan, Europe to reach $3.2 billion goal
news-korea-econ.description: NIIF targets $3.2 billion by attracting investors from Japan and Europe, having secured $2 billion in its latest infrastructure fund.

news-korea-econ.title: My family fled the ‘butchers’ in Iran 50 years ago. We can’t give them what they want
news-korea-econ.description: On Tuesday, Aug. 25, Trump announced the U.S. Navy cleared every Iranian mine from the Strait of Hormuz, but the regime's attrition strategy looms.
